speaker: Unknown
en: Now that the Saspocalypse is over or paused, software is booming.
zh: 既然 Saspocalypse 已经结束或暂停了,软件业正在蓬勃发展。

speaker: Unknown
en: What's happening?
zh: 发生了什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's talk about it with the CEO of Europe's largest software company right after this.
zh: 我们马上与欧洲最大软件公司的 CEO 聊聊这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: This episode is brought to you by Genesis.
zh: 本期节目由 Genesis 呈现。

speaker: Unknown
en: What does it actually take to put agentic AI to work across an entire enterprise?
zh: 要在整个企业范围内让智能体 AI 真正运转起来,究竟需要什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: I recently spoke with Genesis chairman and CEO Tony Bates about why orchestration is emerging as a competitive advantage in customer experience and what companies need to get right in the AI era.
zh: 我最近与 Genesis 董事长兼 CEO Tony Bates 交谈,聊了为什么编排正在成为客户体验中的竞争优势,以及企业在 AI 时代需要做对哪些事情。

speaker: Unknown
en: Then I sat down with Adam Mitchell, head of enterprise business solutions at Voya Financial to go inside a large scale agentic CX transformation
zh: 随后我与 Voya Financial 企业业务解决方案负责人 Adam Mitchell 坐下来,深入了解一场大规模的智能体 CX 转型,

speaker: Unknown
en: including the business decisions, trade-offs, and lessons along the way.
zh: 包括其中的商业决策、权衡取舍以及一路走来的经验教训。

speaker: Unknown
en: You can watch both conversations now on my YouTube channel today.
zh: 你现在就可以在我的 YouTube 频道上观看这两场对话。

speaker: Unknown
en: Welcome to Big Technology Podcast, a show for cool-headed and nuanced conversation of the tech world and beyond.
zh: 欢迎收听 Big Technology Podcast,这是一个对科技世界及其他领域进行冷静、细致对话的节目。

speaker: Unknown
en: We have a great show for you today.
zh: 我们今天有一期很棒的节目。

speaker: Unknown
en: Today, we're joined by the CEO of SAP, Christian Klein, who's here to talk with us about the state of software amid all these SaaS-pocalypse worries, and along with some other big decisions that software companies are faced with today, everything from hiring to the integration of artificial intelligence and more.
zh: 今天,我们请到了 SAP 的 CEO Christian Klein,他将与我们聊聊在 Saspocalypse 担忧之下软件业的现状,以及软件公司如今面临的其他重大决策,从招聘到人工智能的整合等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: Great to see you.
zh: 很高兴见到你。

speaker: Unknown
en: Welcome to the show.
zh: 欢迎来到节目。

speaker: Unknown
en: What a great introduction.
zh: 多么精彩的介绍。

speaker: Unknown
en: Thanks for having me, Alex.
zh: 谢谢你邀请我,Alex。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay.
zh: 好。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, you know, we talk a lot about software on the show and AI on the show, and we don't really have to, you know, when we say we think AI is going to do this or that, you know, we don't have to make any planning decisions based off it.
zh: 你知道,我们在节目中聊了很多软件和 AI 的话题,而我们其实不必——你知道,当我们说我们认为 AI 将会做这个或那个时,我们不必据此做出任何规划决策。

speaker: Unknown
en: We just talk about it on the next show.
zh: 我们只是在下一期节目里继续聊它。

speaker: Unknown
en: You, on the other hand, you do need to make planning decisions.
zh: 而你,另一方面,你确实需要做出规划决策。

speaker: Unknown
en: You have to basically decide, and this is why I think it's going to be such an interesting conversation, you have to basically decide what you think the trajectory of AI's progress is going to be, and then you plan based on top of it.
zh: 你必须基本上做出判断——这也是我认为这场对话会如此有趣的原因——你必须基本判断出你认为 AI 进步的轨迹会是什么样的,然后在此基础上进行规划。

speaker: Unknown
en: Because if AI stops now, it's one set of decisions.
zh: 因为如果 AI 现在就停下来,那是一套决策。

speaker: Unknown
en: If AI keeps going a little bit, but then hits a wall, it's another set of decisions.
zh: 如果 AI 再前进一点,但随后撞上了墙,那是另一套决策。

speaker: Unknown
en: And if we go into recursive self-improvement,
zh: 而如果我们进入递归自我改进,

speaker: Unknown
en: It's a third set.
zh: 那就是第三套决策了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Each one of these impacts your business dramatically.
zh: 这些情景中的每一种都会对你的业务产生巨大影响。

speaker: Unknown
en: So actually, you make the choice and then you run a company based off of it.
zh: 所以说,你做出选择,然后基于它来经营一家公司。

speaker: Unknown
en: I think that AI has to hit.
zh: 我认为 AI 必须会撞上。

speaker: Unknown
en: A wall at some point.
zh: 某一堵墙。

speaker: Unknown
en: We've seen great progress, progress that's gone through many walls that people put up or presumed walls and it's continued to build, but it can't keep going on this like this forever.
zh: 我们已经看到了巨大的进步,那些进步穿过了人们竖起的或假想的许多墙并持续构建,但它不可能永远这样继续下去。

speaker: Unknown
en: What do you think?
zh: 你怎么想?

speaker: Unknown
en: And do you think we're about to hit like recursive self-improvement or do you think that what I'm saying makes a little sense?
zh: 你认为我们即将进入递归自我改进吗?还是你觉得我说的有点道理?

speaker: Unknown
en: I'm happy to answer that question.
zh: 我很乐意回答这个问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: And let me maybe just describe it, how I describe it to my employees.
zh: 让我也许先描述一下——我是怎么向我的员工描述它的。

speaker: Unknown
en: When we do in all hands, I always show them a mountain.
zh: 在我们开全员大会时,我总是给他们看一座山。

speaker: Unknown
en: I said, look, we climbed the cloud mountain.
zh: 我说,看,我们攀登了云这座山。

speaker: Unknown
en: We did a cloud transformation.
zh: 我们完成了云转型。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then now we have to climb the AI mountain.
zh: 而现在我们必须攀登 AI 这座山。

speaker: Unknown
en: Journey, there will be obstacles that we have to overcome.
zh: 在这段旅程中,会有我们必须克服的障碍。

speaker: Unknown
en: AI has to overcome.
zh: AI 必须克服的障碍。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when all of this hype started with Generative AI, I mean, of course, everyone was using all these LLM models and start testing it, experimenting with it.
zh: 当所有这些围绕生成式 AI 的炒作开始时,我是说,当然,所有人都在使用这些 LLM 模型,开始测试它、试验它。

speaker: Unknown
en: And now it's really about, okay, but it's nice to experiment with it.
zh: 而现在真正的关键是,好吧,试验它当然很好。

speaker: Unknown
en: All of our customers are saying, okay, but what is in it?
zh: 我们所有的客户都在说,好吧,但这里面有什么?

speaker: Unknown
en: Show me the value.
zh: 给我看价值。

speaker: Unknown
en: And why does AI understand so much all the unstructured documents?
zh: 还有,为什么 AI 能理解这么多非结构化文档?

speaker: Unknown
en: I can summarize a mail, I can summarize a document and so on.
zh: 我可以总结一封邮件,我可以总结一份文档,等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: But what about the business?
zh: 但业务呢?

speaker: Unknown
en: Why is there always certain limits with the accuracy?
zh: 为什么准确率总是存在某些限制?

speaker: Unknown
en: So that is the first obstacle we have to overcome.
zh: 所以那是我们必须克服的第一个障碍。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the third one, I guess the world is talking about that.
zh: 而第三个,我猜全世界都在谈论它。

speaker: Unknown
en: Do we need to regulate AI?
zh: 我们需要监管 AI 吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Do we need to govern AI?
zh: 我们需要治理 AI 吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: Because obviously, when you're running the world's most mission critical businesses, I mean, obviously governance plays a huge role.
zh: 因为显然，当你在运营全球最关键任务型的业务时，我是说，显然治理起着巨大的作用。

speaker: Unknown
en: And this is where I would say these are the kinds of obstacles we have to overcome to further, you know, climb up the mountain.
zh: 而这就是我要说的，这些就是我们必须克服的障碍，以便进一步，你知道，攀登这座高山。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay, well, Christian, so this is kind of the core question here.
zh: 好，那么，Christian，这就是这里的核心问题了。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah, all right, AI doesn't understand structured data that well right now, I think.
zh: 是的，好吧，我认为 AI 现在对结构化数据的理解还不是很好。

speaker: Unknown
en: But your job is basically, a big part of your job is assessing whether the technology will be making those leaps in the future.
zh: 但你的工作基本上是，你工作的很大一部分是评估这项技术未来是否会实现那些飞跃。

speaker: Unknown
en: So we could talk a lot about what the current state of AI is, and we will.
zh: 所以我们可以大量谈论 AI 目前的状态，我们也会谈的。

speaker: Unknown
en: But for you to run the company, right?
zh: 但对于你运营公司来说，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: Let's say AI, for instance, gets really good at going into ERP and being able to make
zh: 比方说，例如 AI 变得非常擅长进入 ERP 并能够做出

speaker: Unknown
en: Serious calculations about things, which it's getting better at.
zh: 关于各种事情的严肃计算，它正在变得越来越好。

speaker: Unknown
en: And SAP's business, I should say.
zh: 我应该说，是 SAP 的业务。

speaker: Unknown
en: It's enterprise resource planning.
zh: 这是企业资源规划。

speaker: Unknown
en: That means that it brings together systems like finance, HR, manufacturing, supply chain and sales into a single system, single soft forces.
zh: 这意味着它把财务、人力资源、制造、供应链和销售这些系统整合到一个单一系统中，单一软 forces。

speaker: Unknown
en: So your job is basically to figure out, big part of your job is to figure out whether AI will be able to overcome those obstacles, what timeframe AI is going to overcome those obstacles in, and then how you adjust.
zh: 所以你的工作基本上是，你工作的很大一部分是弄清楚 AI 是否能够克服那些障碍，AI 会在什么时间范围内克服那些障碍，然后你如何调整。

speaker: Unknown
en: So do you think it's going to get over the hump is basically the question I'm asking.
zh: 所以基本上我问的问题是，你认为它能不能翻过这个坎。

speaker: Unknown
en: And I would say, look, I mean, you know, we, for example, code financial closing agents, and we are sitting here at the WallSuite.
zh: 而且我会说，你看，我是说，你知道，我们，例如，编写财务结账智能体，而我们现在正坐在 WallSuite 这里。

speaker: Unknown
en: And of course, they work today.
zh: 当然，它们今天就能工作。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, AI understands business, but, you know, maybe it understands today with a 93% accuracy.
zh: 我是说，AI 理解业务，但是，你知道，也许它今天的理解准确率是 93%。

speaker: Unknown
en: Your auditors, when you release financial results, they say, okay, so this time my numbers were 7%, you know, too high.
zh: 你的审计师，当你发布财务业绩时，他们会说，好，那么这次我的数字高了你懂的，7%。

speaker: Unknown
en: And they say, well, what?
zh: 他们会说，嗯，什么？

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, you know, you need audits, it needs to be certified and so on.
zh: 我是说，你知道，你需要审计，它需要被认证等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's 100% accuracy is needed.
zh: 所以需要 100% 的准确率。

speaker: Unknown
en: And that's where I guess every tech company is now working on.
zh: 而我想现在每家科技公司都在为此努力。

speaker: Unknown
en: And, you know, every software player is now using, especially SAP, as we have so much knowledge about industries, processes and data.
zh: 而且，你知道，每个软件玩家现在都在利用，尤其是 SAP，因为我们对行业、流程和数据有如此多的了解。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, we are working this on a constant basis.
zh: 我是说，我们在持续不断地做这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And yes, of course,
zh: 而且是的，当然，

speaker: Unknown
en: AI understands business, but sometimes you need an accuracy of 100%, 90% accuracy is not enough.
zh: AI 理解业务，但有时你需要 100% 的准确率，90% 的准确率是不够的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then when it comes to governance, I mean, here in the US, when we are running the US government, when we are running, you know, many public sector customers, you know, agents need to understand what is FATRAM.
zh: 然后说到治理，我是说，在美国这里，当我们运营美国政府时，当我们运营，你知道，许多公共部门客户时，你知道，智能体需要理解什么是 FATRAM。

speaker: Unknown
en: That, you know, which data can I access?
zh: 那就是，你知道，我可以访问哪些数据？

speaker: Unknown
en: What data can I share?
zh: 我可以分享什么数据？

speaker: Unknown
en: Where is the data going to be stored?
zh: 数据将被存储在哪里？

speaker: Unknown
en: And so that is also the governance part and we are working on that.
zh: 这也是治理的一部分，我们正在这方面努力。

speaker: Unknown
en: So for me, Alex, this is more a question of now months until we are really reaching a level where you can really trust AI running your business.
zh: 所以对我而言，Alex，这更多是一个还有几个月的问题，直到我们真正达到一个你可以真正信任 AI 运营你的业务的水平。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then you can still decide, okay, the human is in the loop for us.
zh: 然后你仍然可以决定，好，对我们来说人在回路中。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's a rule.
zh: 那是一条规则。

speaker: Unknown
en: But then you can really decide on the autonomous level of the agents on how autonomous can the agents run the business.
zh: 但然后你就可以真正决定智能体的自主级别，智能体可以在多大的自主程度上运营业务。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay.
zh: 好。

speaker: Unknown
en: So this is important.
zh: 所以这一点很重要。

speaker: Unknown
en: So your perspective is within months, AI can go from basically working within software and giving us, giving your customers like 90 something percent accuracy.
zh: 所以你的观点是在几个月内，AI 可以从基本上在软件内工作并给我们、给你的客户提供 90% 多的准确率。

speaker: Unknown
en: You anticipate a hundred percent accuracy within months.
zh: 你预计在几个月内达到 100% 的准确率。

speaker: Unknown
en: I would say that's absolutely possible.
zh: 我会说这绝对有可能。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's for certain tasks.
zh: 所以这是针对某些任务的。

speaker: Unknown
en: And obviously, we will then develop the next agents for supply chain optimization.
zh: 显然，我们接下来会开发下一个用于供应链优化的智能体。

speaker: Unknown
en: And then, you know, here we are maybe there in eight to nine months.
zh: 然后，你知道，我们可能八到九个月后在那里实现。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, but it's not, we are now talking not anymore about years.
zh: 所以，但这已经不是，我们现在谈论的不再是按年计算了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So business AI is real, business AI is coming.
zh: 所以商业 AI 是真实的，商业 AI 正在到来。

speaker: Unknown
en: And also, 100% accuracy is not always needed.
zh: 而且，100% 的准确率也并不总是需要的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, for example, when I do my customer visits here in New York, I'm asking Juulworks to put me to get a customer briefing.
zh: 我是说，例如，当我在纽约进行我的客户拜访时，我让 Juulworks 帮我安排客户简报。

speaker: Unknown
en: Exactly.
zh: 没错。

speaker: Unknown
en: Jules is our co-worker.
zh: Jules 是我们的同事。

speaker: Unknown
en: And when it's 90% accurate, it's totally fine.
zh: 当它有 90% 准确的时候，就完全没问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Maybe when I ask for the latest earnings and it's not exactly the latest earnings, maybe it's the earnings before, okay, I mean, who cares?
zh: 比如我问最新的财报，它给我的不是最新的财报，而是上一期的财报，好吧，我是说，谁在乎呢？

speaker: Unknown
en: And there, 95% accuracy is totally fine, but I don't need a bunch of people in my office preparing me for these customer meetings and winding all of these briefings because I get the data out of SAP.
zh: 在那里，95% 的准确率完全没问题，但我不需要一屋子人帮我准备客户会议、整理所有这些简报，因为我是直接从 SAP 拿数据的。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, the public content is anyway understood by the LLM.
zh: 我是说，公开内容反正 LLM 都能理解。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, you know, here we go.
zh: 所以，你懂的，就是这样。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it really also depends a little bit on the AI use case.
zh: 所以这其实也在一定程度上取决于 AI 的使用场景。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yeah.
zh: 是啊。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay.
zh: 好。

speaker: Unknown
en: So a hundred percent.
zh: 所以，百分之百。

speaker: Unknown
en: That's, that's really interesting because I think the big thing that has been holding back a lot of enterprise rollout and the ability of enterprises to integrate this technology has been the fact that, yeah, if you're doing something like tax supply chain, projecting your sales pipeline and you're at like 92%, might as well not use it.
zh: 这，这真的很有意思，因为我认为一直阻碍很多企业落地、阻碍企业整合这项技术的一大关键，就是这样一个事实：是的，如果你在做税务、供应链、销售管线预测这类事情，而你的准确率只有 92% 左右，那还不如不用。

speaker: Unknown
en: And you could check the work, but you don't know where the problems are.
zh: 你可以检查工作成果，但你不知道问题出在哪里。

speaker: Unknown
en: Can you ask another chat about where are the problems?
zh: 你可以再问另一个聊天机器人问题出在哪吗？

speaker: Unknown
en: If it finds 90% of those problems, you now have a compounding issue.
zh: 如果它只找到了其中 90% 的问题，那现在你就有了一个复合叠加的问题。

speaker: Unknown
en: Yes.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: But things change when it gets to 100.
zh: 但当它达到 100 的时候，情况就变了。

speaker: Unknown
en: So I think the way that you're framing it is we're about to see a real...
zh: 所以我认为你这样框定问题的方式是，我们即将看到一场真正的……

speaker: Unknown
en: Explosion of enterprise AI use.
zh: 企业 AI 使用的爆发。

speaker: Unknown
en: It depends on the AI use case.
zh: 这取决于 AI 的使用场景。

speaker: Unknown
en: It also depends just, you know, an hour ago, I visited a big customer here in New York and they said, oh, Christian, you know, I love your financial closing assistant, but it's only 93% accurate.
zh: 它还取决于，你懂的，一小时前，我拜访了纽约这里的一个大客户，他们说：哦，Christian，你知道，我很喜欢你的财务结账助手，但它只有 93% 的准确率。

speaker: Unknown
en: But okay, there are 100 finance systems wanting, hanging somewhere around in this company, someone on SAP.
zh: 不过好吧，这家公司里挂着、飘着一百个财务系统，其中某个在 SAP 上。

speaker: Unknown
en: So, okay, we need to clean up the house.
zh: 所以，好吧，我们需要先清理门户。

speaker: Unknown
en: I mean, you know, your data is a mess.
zh: 我是说，你懂的，你的数据是一团糟。

speaker: Unknown
en: So it's also not only the agent per se, so it's also the
zh: 所以这也不仅仅在于智能体本身，还在于

speaker: Unknown
en: Data, the data quality, the data silos in a company where we then need to match data so that the agent can really understand, okay, where does all the financial data sit?
zh: 数据、数据质量、公司里的数据孤岛，我们需要匹配数据，让智能体真正理解：好，所有的财务数据都存在哪里？

speaker: Unknown
en: How do I depreciate a certain asset?
zh: 我该如何对某项资产进行折旧？

speaker: Unknown
en: And so on.
zh: 等等。

speaker: Unknown
en: And the more systems you have and the more you lack data quality, I mean, of course, this also then reduces the accuracy of your AI agent.
zh: 而你的系统越多、数据质量越差，我是说，这当然也会降低你的 AI 智能体的准确率。

speaker: Unknown
en: Okay.
zh: 好。

speaker: Unknown
en: But I thought smarter and smarter AI was supposed to solve that problem, right?
zh: 但我以为越来越聪明的 AI 本应解决这个问题，对吧？

speaker: Unknown
en: The big, one of the big reasons that Enterprise Pointat for like not being able to roll out AI, like there are all these stats about like one in 20 pilots or one in 10 pilots actually make it to production.
zh: 企业无法落地 AI 的一大原因——有这样一些统计，比如说二十分之一的试点项目、或十分之一的试点项目能真正进入生产环境——

speaker: Unknown
en: Yes.
zh: 是的。

speaker: Unknown
en: Is because the systems are working on sort of faulty data foundations.
zh: 是因为这些系统是在某种程度上有缺陷的数据基础之上运行的。

speaker: Unknown
en: But, you know, is the AI at the point where it's getting good enough to figure that out on its own?
zh: 但是，你知道，AI 现在是否已经到了足够好、能够自己搞清楚这一点的地步？

speaker: Unknown
en: Like companies are putting teams and teams on this to try to figure it out.
zh: 比如公司们正在派一个又一个团队去试图搞清楚这件事。

speaker: Unknown
en: But why is the AI sort of not able to do that on its own?
